title: Turkey with vegetable, stuffing, diet frozen meal

content.title: About
content.content: Turkey with vegetable, stuffing is a ready‑to‑heat diet frozen meal containing turkey pieces, a blend of vegetables (carrot, broccoli, cauliflower) and a light whole‑grain rice stuffing with herbs. The meal is designed for quick microwave preparation and fits a controlled‑calorie diet.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Turkey is one of the leanest meats, high in protein and low in calories.
Vegetables are flash‑frozen, preserving most of their vitamins and minerals.
Diet frozen meals are often formulated to balance macronutrients: roughly 30 % calories from protein, 30 % from fat and 40 % from carbs.
The product contains no artificial colors or flavors, only natural spices.
Packaging is made from recyclable plastic, reducing environmental impact.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: Turkey provides about 20 g of protein per serving, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Low calorie count
items.content: The meal is around 250 kcal, making it suitable for weight‑management plans.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Turkey and vegetables supply B3, B6 and B12 vitamins important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Vegetables and whole‑grain stuffing deliver roughly 5 g of fiber, aiding digestion.

items.title: Low sodium level
items.content: The recipe uses a modest amount of salt, beneficial for blood‑pressure control.

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to bird meat and should avoid the product.

items.title: Presence of glutamate
items.content: Certain formulations may contain sodium glutamate, which can trigger headaches in sensitive people.

items.title: Must be heated to 75 °C
items.content: Insufficient heating may leave live bacteria; follow the recommended heating time.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Microwave the frozen meal according to the package directions (typically 3–4 minutes on high), stir, and let stand for 1 minute. Serve as a standalone lunch or with a light side salad.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the product frozen at –18 °C or lower. Once the package is opened and transferred to the fridge, consume within 24 hours.
